news.title: Paper Accepted at AAAI 2025
news.content: Our work on "Deep Generative Model for Mechanical System Configuration Design" has been accepted at AAAI 2025.

news.title: XLB Library Showcased at NVIDIA Booth in SC24
news.content: Our open-source XLB library was showcased at the NVIDIA booth during SC (Super Computing) 2024. XLB is a differentiable massively parallel Lattice Boltzmann library in Python that leverages hardware acceleration through JAX and NVIDIA Warp backends.

news.title: Featured in York University Article on AI in Education
news.content: My course at York University was featured in an article about AI integration in education at the Lassonde School of Engineering.

news.title: New Course at York University
news.content: Started teaching "AI and Generative Design for Mechanical Systems" at York University.

news.title: Started Teaching at University of Toronto
news.content: Began teaching "Introduction to Machine Learning with Python" at the University of Toronto (graduate course).
